content.value_statement: Email teams can send broken greetings, empty offers, or unnecessary personal data when personalization fields are incomplete. This skill creates a merge-tag and conditional-content specification with fallbacks, catch-all branches, and PII controls.
actual_capabilities: Maps each requested merge tag to a supplied export column.
Defines a readable fallback for every merge tag.
Creates if, elseif, and else content rules for named segments.
Audits worst-case rendering when fields are empty.
Identifies fields that should not appear in visible email content.
Flags promotional wording that needs approved claim support.
limitations: It does not create segments or write the base email copy.
It needs column names, segment definitions, and fill rates from the user.
It does not connect to an ESP or deploy a template.
It cannot verify claims without an approved claims source.

use_cases.title: Prepare a lifecycle campaign
use_cases.description: Add safe first-name and product-category personalization to an existing retention email.

use_cases.title: Review a B2B outreach template
use_cases.description: Define grounded conditional lines for named account segments and safe defaults for missing fields.

use_cases.title: Audit a newsletter module
use_cases.description: Check dynamic modules for empty fields, missing branches, and visible PII before rendering.

prompt_templates.title: Add simple fallbacks
prompt_templates.prompt: Add merge tags with safe fallbacks to this email. Available columns are first_name and city. Use promo mode.

prompt_templates.title: Create segment variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Create conditional blocks for champions, at-risk customers, and everyone else. Use this email and segment map.

prompt_templates.title: Run a safety audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this personalized email template for empty-field renders, missing conditional defaults, and visible PII. Use these columns and fill rates.

prompt_templates.title: Build a full personalization specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete personalization specification for this newsletter. Include tag mappings, rendered fallbacks, conditional rules, PII decisions, worst-case renders, and claim flags.

output_examples.input: Personalize a greeting with first_name, which is sometimes empty.
output: Safety result: No empty greeting can render.

output_examples.input: Show loyalty content to champions and a default offer to all other subscribers.
output: Rule: champions receive the loyalty content.
Else branch: all other subscribers receive the base offer.
Safety result: Every subscriber receives valid content.

best_practices: Provide real column names and fill rates before requesting personalization.
Use a catch-all else branch for every conditional content block.
Use aggregate data only and keep sensitive PII out of visible copy.
anti_patterns: Do not use a merge tag without a natural fallback.
Do not create conditional rules for undefined or stale segments.
Do not paste subscriber rows or use email addresses, phone numbers, or order IDs in examples.

faq.question: Does this skill write a complete email?
faq.answer: No. It personalizes existing email copy and does not create the base subject, body, or call to action.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the existing email, named segments or column names, campaign mode, and fill rates when available.

faq.question: What happens when a field is empty?
faq.answer: The skill defines a fallback or recommends a conditional block so the email remains readable.

faq.question: Can it create customer segments?
faq.answer: No. It uses existing named segments and flags missing segment definitions.

faq.question: Does it send emails or access my ESP?
faq.answer: No. It produces a specification and does not deploy templates or connect to an ESP.

faq.question: How does it handle personal data?
faq.answer: It works from column names and aggregate rules, blocks sensitive fields from visible copy, and avoids raw subscriber data.
